title: Polixis MCP Values
description: Values for the Polixis MCP Helm chart. A Python FastMCP server on the base chart. Exposure uses base chart Gateway API routes (no custom Ingress).

mcpConfig.description: Per-deployment, non-secret settings mapped to environment variables on the app container. A field renders only when set, so an empty or null one keeps the app default. Takes precedence over the same variable under env. Secrets stay in envVars.

enabled.description: If disabled, none of the fields below are mapped to environment variables.

baseUrl.description: MCP_BASE_URL. The public https origin, without the MCP path. Must match routes.hostname.

auth.description: How users sign in. With mode zitadel, zitadel.baseUrl and zitadel.clientId are required.

mode.description: MCP_AUTH_MODE. zitadel signs users in through Zitadel. none serves without sign-in, which the app allows on loopback only: never for a deployment.

zitadel.description: The Zitadel sign-in, read when mode is zitadel. Its secrets, ZITADEL_CLIENT_SECRET and ZITADEL_JWT_SIGNING_KEY, stay in envVars.

baseUrl.description: ZITADEL_BASE_URL. The Zitadel issuer users sign in with, e.g. https://id.<tenant>.unique.app.

clientId.description: ZITADEL_CLIENT_ID. The client id of the MCP's OIDC application in Zitadel. Not a secret.

orgId.description: ZITADEL_ORG_ID. Restricts sign-in to one organisation. Empty allows every organisation.

tokenUrl.description: UPSTREAM_TOKEN_URL. App default: Polixis's production Keycloak realm.

maxConcurrentRequests.description: UPSTREAM_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS. Requests to Polixis at once, per process. App default: 4.

quotaCooldownSeconds.description: UPSTREAM_QUOTA_COOLDOWN_SECONDS. How long a process stops calling Polixis after it answers that the API request limit is exceeded. App default: 900.

retry.description: Retries of a throttled (429) or unavailable (503) answer. An exceeded API request limit is never retried.

enabled.description: UPSTREAM_RETRY_ENABLED. false sends every request once. App default: true.

maxAttempts.description: UPSTREAM_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS, the first attempt included. App default: 5.

maxWaitSeconds.description: UPSTREAM_RETRY_MAX_WAIT_SECONDS. The longest wait before a retry; an answer asking for longer is not retried. App default: 30.

rateLimit.description: Per-user limit on tool calls, counted in each replica.

logging.description: Logging and error-detail settings. An empty value leaves its variable unset, which keeps the app default.

level.description: LOG_LEVEL. The level of polixis-mcp's own loggers. Chart default: info.

libraryLevels.description: LIBRARY_LOG_LEVELS, rendered as JSON. Logger name to level, merged over the app's defaults. A library not named logs at INFO. Empty keeps the defaults.

diagnosticsDataPolicy.description: LOGS_DIAGNOSTICS_DATA_POLICY. conceal writes identifying values as hmac-sha256:<hex>; disclose writes the original, for debugging. Chart default: conceal.

errorDetailsPolicy.description: ERROR_DETAILS_POLICY. redact keeps exception messages and stack text out of logs and spans; disclose keeps them, for debugging. Chart default: redact.
